articles.title: The Ethereum Foundation unveils new 'Clear Signing' standard to stop users from approving malicious crypto transactions
articles.snippet: The move comes after billions in losses from phishing attacks and wallet drains, with Ethereum pushing to make transaction approvals safer and easier to understand.

articles.title: Binance's chief marketing officer Rachel Conlan to leave the exchange
articles.snippet: Eowyn Chen, former CEO of Trust Wallet, will serve as her interim replacement.

articles.title: Exodus dumps 1,000 bitcoin: Why the crypto wallet is cashing out to fund a payments empire
articles.snippet: Exodus sold $73.2M in crypto, causing cash, cash equivalents, and stablecoins to jump from $5.2M to $74.4M by the end of Q1 2026.

articles.title: Rewardy Wallet launches global multi-chain swap campaign with incentives
articles.snippet: Self-custody wallet by Chainwith opens two-week user activation across Ethereum, BNB Chain, Solana, and Aptos, with prizes starting at $100.

articles.title: Circle stock rallies 15% as Wall Street sees further upside in stablecoin adoption
articles.snippet: Circle shares surged as analysts pointed to expanding stablecoin use cases and forecast significant upside as USDC adoption continues to gain traction.
